features.title: Everything you need for coaching
features.description: A modern, clean platform that provides all the tools for professional and scalable client management.

clientManagement.title: Client Management
clientManagement.description: All your client data in one central place with full overview.
clientManagement.long: Detailed client profiles: personal data, health status (conditions, allergies, injuries), emergency contacts, goals, and coach notes. All important information at your fingertips.

calendar.title: Appointment Management & Calendar
calendar.description: Full calendar management with all your appointments and events.
calendar.long: Multiple appointment types: workout, consultation, measurement, or other. You can assign clients, add locations, online meeting links, and extra notes to each appointment. Each event type is color-coded.

workout.title: Workout Planning
workout.description: Personalized workout plans with exercises and daily breakdown.
workout.long: Create weekly workout plans broken down by day. For each exercise, you can specify sets, reps, weights, and rest time. The system supports both strength and cardio exercises.

meal.title: Meal Planning & Shopping
meal.description: Weekly meal planning, smart shopping list, and macro tracking.
meal.long: Plan weekly meals broken down by day and meal time. For each food item, you can specify quantity, calories, and macros (protein, carbs, fat). Each meal plan includes a global shopping list, options, and notes.
features: Options and notes for each food item

chat.title: Chat & Communication
chat.description: Direct, real-time messaging with clients with read receipts.
chat.long: Separate chat interface for each client with messages displayed chronologically, grouped by date. Message read status (two checkmarks) indicates when the other party has read the message.

pricing.title: Choose the plan that fits you
pricing.description: All plans come with a no-questions-asked 30-day money-back guarantee. Above the client cap, you only pay per extra client — no sudden plan upgrade pressure.

growing.name: Growing
growing.description: For coaches with an expanding client base

scaling.name: Scaling
scaling.description: For coaches with a large active client portfolio

cta.title: Take your coaching
cta.description: Join the most innovative coaches who are already using TRENIQ to reduce daily administration and increase their revenue.
cta.subtext: No credit card required. 14-day free trial.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: All important answers in one place to help you decide and get started with TRENIQ.

item1.question: Can I try TRENIQ for free?
item1.answer: Yes! TRENIQ offers a 14-day free trial period where you can test all features. No credit card required for registration, no hidden obligations, and you can cancel anytime.

item2.question: How much does TRENIQ cost and what plans are available?

item3.question: What coaching areas can the platform be used for?
item3.answer: TRENIQ is absolutely universal: perfect for personal trainers, fitness instructors, strength coaches, yoga teachers, nutritionists, and lifestyle coaches. Its modular design adapts flexibly to your unique workflow.

item4.question: How can I manage my clients' data in the system?
item4.answer: You get a dedicated, private profile for each client. You can manage personal data, health questionnaires, anthropometric measurements, photos, workout plans, and meal plans all in one place. Only you and the specific client can access the data.

item6.question: What security level does the system provide for data?
item6.answer: Data security is our top priority. TRENIQ uses bank-grade SSL/TLS encryption for data transmission, and data is stored on strictly protected European servers. Automatic backups are made hourly, so nothing is lost.

item7.question: Can I collaborate with other coaches on the platform?
item7.answer: The Scaling plan is specifically designed for gyms, studios, or coaching collectives to work together. You can manage colleague permissions, share the exercise database, and the studio calendar.

item9.question: Can I import my existing clients' data from Excel?
item9.answer: Absolutely. TRENIQ has an intelligent Excel/CSV import module. Just upload your existing spreadsheet and the system generates client profiles in seconds. If you get stuck, our support team will help you migrate the data for free.

item10.question: What languages is the interface available in?
item10.answer: The platform is currently fully available in Hungarian, Slovak, and English. This applies not only to the coach interface: your clients will also receive their app and automatic email/push notifications in their preferred language.
